The Guardian (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s0-TXXwz3AU): Wafa released the CCTV; 'No shooter can be seen in the footage and the IDF did not immediately comment.' Reuters, asked the IDF about the footage, quotes it as saying 'Earlier today, during IDF activity in the Jenin Camp, a number of suspects hurled ...' (the rest of the quote is in the Reuters article; I saw only that excerpt) (https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/four-palestinians-including-two-children-killed-by-israeli-forces-west-bank-2023-11-29/). Attribution: Palestinian health ministry, AJE, family; no shooter in frame.

Reuters (uploaded 25 Dec 2023), 'GRAPHIC WARNING: Israeli airstrikes kill 100 in one of war's deadliest nights': a hospital forecourt in the rain with rows of white body bags, night strike flashes, smoke over Gaza, drone footage of flattened blocks, and PRCS ambulance footage (credit 'Palestine Red Crescent/Mohammed Suleiman'). APT vertical (tag 'KHAN YOUNIS, GAZA'): Israeli strike on a house in Khan Younis, 9 Sep 2026, after an evacuation warning; no immediate casualties. APT is an aggregator and does not credit the camera; the angle matches other wire coverage of the same day (cf. Anadolu clip anadolu-khanyounis-plume-2026-09-09) - use with that caveat.
